from:
title: "You're up to date!",
		message: `T3 Code ${updateState.currentVersion} is currently the newest version available.`,
		buttons: ["OK"]
to:
title: "已是最新版本！",
		message: `T3 Code ${updateState.currentVersion} 已是目前最新的版本。`,
		buttons: ["確定"]

from:
title: "Update check failed",
		message: "Could not check for updates.",
		detail: updateState.message ?? "An unknown error occurred. Please try again later.",
		buttons: ["OK"]
to:
title: "檢查更新失敗",
		message: "無法檢查更新。",
		detail: updateState.message ?? "發生未知錯誤，請稍後再試。",
		buttons: ["確定"]

from:
title: "Updates unavailable",
			message: "Automatic updates are not available right now.",
			detail: disabledReason.value,
			buttons: ["OK"]
to:
title: "無法更新",
			message: "目前無法使用自動更新。",
			detail: disabledReason.value,
			buttons: ["確定"]

from: showErrorBox("WSL backend is still unavailable", `${reason}\n\nT3 Code will use the Windows backend for this launch and retry WSL the next time the app starts.`)
to: showErrorBox("WSL 後端仍無法使用", `${reason}\n\n這次啟動 T3 Code 會使用 Windows 後端，下次啟動時會再嘗試 WSL。`)

from: showErrorBox("WSL backend couldn't start", `${reason}\n\nFalling back to the Windows backend so T3 Code can open. Re-enable the WSL backend from Settings > Sharing & access once the WSL distro is fixed.`)
to: showErrorBox("WSL 後端無法啟動", `${reason}\n\n改用 Windows 後端讓 T3 Code 可以開啟。WSL 發行版修好後，請到「設定 > 分享與存取」重新啟用 WSL 後端。`)
